title: Court Documents Suggest Rebel Wilson Ordered Websites Attacking Producer
summary: New documents filed on Tuesday in Los Angeles appear to show that Ms. Wilson, the actress, was heavily involved in disparaging Amanda Ghost, a producer on her movie, “The Deb.”
